spans.s: --on the नर्मदा; the confluence of the ऐरण्डी with the नर्मदा is deemed very sacred. M. १९१. ४२-7; १९३. ६५.

(II)--the नाग presiding over the month of तपस्य (फल्गुन);
1: भा. XII. ११. ४०; Br. II. २३. 3 and १४;

(III)--Bhauvana got hold of the sun's अण्ड- कपाल and sang the रथन्तर portion of सामगान when an elephant appeared given to इरावति as son. Hence ऐरावत the vehicle of Indra--the first king among elephants;
1: वा. ६९. २०९-11;
--the उत्तरस्थानम्; has three roads or वीथिस्। वा. ६६. ४७-48.

--R. A beautiful stream originating from the Himalayas, likened to a lady; served daily by Indra;
1: M. ११४. २१; ११५. १८-19; ११

.
the region surrounding its source described.
2: M. ११
--Here are the constellations पुष्य, आश्लेष and आदित्य (पुनर्वसु-वा। प्।); in the उत्तरमार्ग of the sun. Br.
--a son of इरावती--the vehicle of Indra, also इरावत. Br.
